out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: Observed the handsink near the 3 compartment sink being used to store wet wiping cloths.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. PIC removed wet wiping cloths from hand sink. Please ensure continuous compliance.

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wiping Cloths Stored in Sanitizer Solution
violations.observation: Wet wiping cloths used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces were observed stored on the counter. Observed wet wiping cloths stored at hand sink near 3 compartment sink.
violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloths are to be used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces and are to be held in a chemical sanitizer solution at the appropriate concentration between uses. PIC placed wet wiping cloths in solution with sanitizer.

out_items.name: Utensils, equipment and linens properly stored, dried and handled

violations.title: Wet Wiping Cloths, Laundering
violations.observation: In-use wet wiping cloths are observed to be heavily stained and soiled. Upon discussion with PIC, washer and dryer have not been installed and cloths are not being laundered.
violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloths shall be laundered daily. Please install washer and dryer and ensure cloths are being laundered.

violations.title: Equipment/Utensils Air Drying
violations.observation: Observed cambro and prep containers stacked while wet after cleaning and chemical sanitization (wet nesting).
violations.corrective_action: After cleaning and sanitizing, equipment and utensils shall be air-dried or used after adequate draining before contact with food. EHS discussed proper air drying procedures with PIC during inspection. Please ensure all equipment is fully air dried prior to storing or stacking. Ensure continuous compliance by next routine inspection.
